name: Cooking with shea butter
what_people_do: Use shea butter as a cooking fat in northern Ghana and the savanna belt of West Africa.
why_they_say_it_works: It is the traditional local fat, regarded as healthy and "medicinal".

documented_by.source: Cooking with shea butter and blood pressure, Ghana DHS 2014, 2020, Int J Vitam Nutr Res, PMID 30967105
documented_by.quote_or_summary: Ghana Demographic and Health Survey 2014: 9,396 women and 4,388 men; shea butter consumption recorded.

evidence.tested: Cooking with shea butter vs vegetable oils and blood pressure
evidence.finding: Shea butter use associated with 2.43 mmHg lower systolic and 1.78 mmHg lower diastolic pressure; odds of hypertension 0.75 (CI 0.55 to 1.04, not significant). Authors call for rigorous study designs.

source.name: Cooking with shea butter and blood pressure, Ghana DHS 2014, 2020, Int J Vitam Nutr Res, PMID 30967105

harm_note: No harm identified; it is a saturated-fat food and this is a cross-sectional association.
gaps: Confounding by region and wealth, though adjusted; no trial.
